delivery_semantics: Each explicit owner READY stage is immutably captured before ACK, then published in a distinct CAS-preserving Git commit with its own archive and completed Dropbox/Drive acknowledgments and matching byte sizes. The containing commit identifies its own receipt; actual SHA is carried forward without an extra receipt-only cycle.
